text_block_list.text:
The twinkling stars and black sky gave way
to a purple glow.
――I can still see the color of that
daybreak.
text_block_list.name: Admire Vega

text_block_list.text:
We ran until we couldn't run any more.
The two of us, together.
And then...
it was like my heart started beating
again.
text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The reason I want to live.
The reason I'm here now――

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
......So, um,
that......what I told you earlier...
You misunderstood...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I did?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
When I said you need to think about yourself
more...
I wasn't trying to criticize you..

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I was... I was worried about you...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
......Huh?
You were worried!? What? Why?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You always put the needs of others first...
Like you did at the park.
You only paid attention to what Opera O and
Doto wanted...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Did we think about what you wanted,
even once?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So...
I wanted to know if you got to do what you
wanted to do.
Or didn't do what you didn't want to...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Do you mean...
you've been worrying about me all this
time...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um, well,
don't worry.
I'm not being forced to do anything I don't
want to. I had a ton of fun that day.
So much fun that I want to go again!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Oh, then... That's fine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for not noticing how you felt!
And...
thank you so much for worrying about me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It's not that big a deal. 
You don't need to apologize,
or thank me...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's the kind of...
relationship we have.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san!
It is... Haha, hehehe~

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hang on... what are you laughing for...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I mean... I just can't help it.
Hahaha~

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Please... You really are so...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Ayabe-san.
Can I ask you for advice, one more time?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Mmhm. Of course you can.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So, just to clear up any
misunderstandings.
I'll explain what I really want!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Going out with everyone, making memories,
putting on a play,
I want to do all those things!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Well, really,
I just love spending time with all of you!

Now that you mention it...
Your eyes light up any time we do something
as a group.
text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
The rivals we fight on the turf are special!
The burdens we carry may be heavy,
but even then we won't back down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
We come to understand each other,
and try to overcome each other―― 
I think that's what makes our bonds so
strong!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I― I see.
That's how deeply you cared about us...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Is it not the same for you?
I'm sure you care about us, too!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I don't know.
When it comes to me... and Opera O,
and Doto...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If it wasn't for you,
we'd be a scattered mess.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Scattered...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(...Well,
they do all have strong personalities...
It's hard to imagine them matching someone
else's pace...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I just...
I just want everyone to have as much fun as
they can. 
To me, it's second nature, but... maybe...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Maybe that's what's unique to me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't think the rest of us could do it,
at least.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
――Then I'll keep us all together!
I won't let us get scattered!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Could you come with me, Ayabe-san?
I'm going to go talk to Digital-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So, about my role.
I want to be the one to connect all of us!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to be there for everyone,
to spend time with everyone.
I'll bring our generation together,
on or off the turf!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The kind of king only I can be――
One that brings us all together in
harmony.
That's what I want to be!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The king bringing all the nations together...!
Wuhoho, that's just like Top Road-san! Then,
then, maybe she can go around the kingdoms,
leaving letters for the others to read!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the Mail King... No,
it's missing something!
We need something with Top Road-san's
signature warmth and kindness!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What do you think about "The Santa King"!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
She could bring heartfelt gifts and letters
to all the other kings!
Plus it fits perfectly with the play being
in Christmastime!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The Santa King...!
That sounds great! I like it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A king with a job fits Top Road-san to a
tee too!
So, then,
the reason she reached out to all the others
was out of concern for their loneliness――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uohaha!
The ideas are starting to flow...!
I'm sorry to go,
but I've got to strike while the iron is
hot and focus on writing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Of course! Please do, Digital-chan!
